title: Skill「プロダクトコマーシャル」を選んで生成を開始する
content:
Skill「プロダクトコマーシャル」を選んで生成を開始する  
商品画像1枚と指示文1本だけを入力してCM動画を作る  
Agentに絵コンテ作成→生成→BGM追加→編集までを自動で任せる  
8/18〜9/17はSeedance 2.5を480Pで生成すると1秒4円で作れる  
Minimax H3を768Pで生成すると1秒3円〜で作れる

en.content:
Select the Skill “Product Commercial” to start generating  
Create a CM video by entering just one product image and one instruction prompt  
Let the Agent handle everything automatically, from storyboard creation to generation, BGM addition, and editing  
From 8/18 to 9/17, generating with Seedance 2.5 at 480P costs 4 yen per second  
Generating with Minimax H3 at 768P costs from 3 yen per second

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Full explanation of how to make it on the actual screen (with Zundamon voice, lol)

What I did
1. Select the Skill “Product Commercial”
2. One product image + one instruction prompt
3. Then the Agent takes care of everything from storyboard to generation, BGM, and editing

You can use the Skill here
【https://t.co/zg8cBVhYkH】

From 8/18 to 9/17, Seedance 2.5 (480P) costs 4 yen per second, and Minimax H3 / 768P can be made from 3 yen per second

Skill「프로덕트 커머셜」を 선택하고 생성을 시작한다  
상품 이미지 1장과 지시문 1개만 입력해서 CM 영상을 만든다  
Agent에게 콘티 작성 → 생성 → BGM 추가 → 편집까지 자동으로 맡긴다  
8/18~9/17에는 Seedance 2.5를 480P로 생성하면 1초당 4엔에 만들 수 있다  
Minimax H3를 768P로 생성하면 1초당 3엔~으로 만들 수 있다
